newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: No Australian Treasury note tender this week.
newsitem.headline: No Australian Treasury note tender this week.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will not be holding a Treasury note tender this week, the Reserve Bank of Australia said on Tuesday.
The Treasury last week offered a total of A$1.2 billion of notes, comprising A$600 million of five-week notes and A$600 million of 13-week notes.
There are A$901 million of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending July 3.
